License review:
  No open redistribution license for the statement, input data, generator,
  scorer, or visualizer was found in the official materials. The tool archive
  contains no LICENSE, COPYING, or NOTICE file. The generator Cargo package
  declares no author or license field. This notice grants no additional rights.

Local-preparation restriction:
  The fixed public development data product and images containing it are for
  local preparation only. Do not publicly upload the official archive, the
  reconstructed instances, or those images. Statement, data, generator,
  scorer, visualizer, and independently written solver software retain their
  separate terms; no license from one component is applied to another.

Input reconstruction:
  1. The 100 files tools/in/0000.txt through tools/in/0099.txt are copied
     byte-for-byte to app/instances/. Their combined size is 33,296 bytes.
  2. Five additional public development instances are generated locally with
     the official locked generator and these public-instance seed mappings:

       h00.txt = 250854218785
       h04.txt = 51468017913079
       h19.txt = 129837058162460
       h24.txt = 150636911777541
       h27.txt = 161465247114690

     The generator runs during local preparation with the official Cargo.lock
     and the command:
       cargo run --release --locked --bin gen -- PUBLIC5.seeds.txt --dir OUTPUT_DIR

     Its five sequential outputs are renamed to the five public names above.
     The project-selected build environment is linux/amd64 with rust:1.83-slim;
     upstream does not specify this as the only supported compiler version.
     The final development environment does not require a Rust toolchain.

  3. Output modes are normalized to 0644. The 105 output paths, byte counts,
     and SHA-256 values are checked against the retained manifest. Instance
     text is not edited, reformatted, or recompressed. Total output size is
     34,938 bytes.

Only the five public-instance seed mappings above are included. No complete
random stream, other sampling indices, hidden-instance mapping, judging data,
or standard answer is included. This notice is kept outside app/instances/ so
it does not become an additional public-runner input.
